title: Reversed tarot cards and how to read them
description: Reversed tarot cards explained: what upright and reversed mean, three ways to read a reversed card in a tarot spread, and when to skip reversals.

scenes.headline: Reversed tarot cards and how to read them
scenes.caption: A reversed card is one that lands upside down in your tarot spread. You can read it as a twist on the card's theme, or leave reversals out entirely.
scenes.vo: A reversed card is one that lands upside down in your tarot spread. You can read it as a twist on the card's theme, or leave reversals out entirely.

scenes.headline: Upright and reversed
scenes.caption: A card is upright when it faces you the right way up as you read it, and reversed when it is turned the other way.
scenes.vo: Upright and reversed. A card is upright when it faces you the right way up as you read it, and reversed when it is turned the other way.

scenes.headline: Three ways to read a reversed card
